'''Nightsister 2A''' was in charge of [[Sai Sircu]]'s [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] guards during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
She tried to stop two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. As she died, she told the Jedi that "each time you strike one of us down, another will rise," and slumped onto the ground.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]'' {{1st}}
